acquisition_issues.reason: Displayed ET tipoff has another Central date; date not inferred

data_quality.read_rule: Check game_date against today's Central date and re-evaluate source age at retrieval. generated_at is not a source update. Never answer 'today' with a different-date board.
data_quality.schedule_scope: Haslametrics displayed D1 matchups; official NCAA board unavailable; non-D1 opponents and ambiguous/unresolved games may be missing

board.interpretation_policy: Source observations and system calculations are labeled separately. A discrepant forecast alone cannot explain why a source differs. Source-provided prose is unavailable unless linked; no invented commentary.

noteworthy.criteria: Top five by fresh eligible source range or projected scoring level. Strong agreement: 3+ systems and both ranges <=2 points. Team rank gap >=25 places. Descriptive screens, not optimized thresholds or betting recommendations.
